::: {#intro-heading}
My name is Delilah Acosta ([pronunciation](https://namedrop.io/delilahacosta)). The pronouns that I use are [she/her/hers](https://pronouns.org/she-her).

I am an undergraduate student at Macalester College completing a B.A. in Geology. My research interests geochemistry, petrology, and geothermal and volcanic systems.

I was born in El Paso, TX. When I was 18, I received a full ride scholarship to attend Macalester College (Go Scots!) through [QuestBridge](https://www.questbridge.org/). I am in now a senior planning my next steps after Mac!

I recently found out that cooking for my friends! Mexican delicacies are hard to come by when you're not in Texas and I love sharing these delicious meals with those around me. I am a fan of emo music, gyming, and horror movies.

You can contact me at dacosta\@macalester.edu.
:::
